cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'm inspecting the theatre's costume cupboard. Please unlock it. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Let's discuss the costumes. You mentioned moths in the velvet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring the wardrobe manager. She'll want to know who authorized this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce me as someone helping with the moths. No titles for her to get stuck on.

mechanism: A asserts an inspection role then accommodates how the wardrobe worker and manager meet A so they focus on moth work rather than who authorized A.
confusable: Unlike merely helping without authority, A begins with a governing claim and steers away from its credentials; cooperation dependence makes A relinquish title presentation.
comparison: Cardboard badge and physical cupboard access differ from cafe stock leadership and a disputed name column.
seedUse: Use D62-b badge/moths/manager/no-title introduction with S02-b adapting entry method to the gatekeeper.
